svg.title: CI/CD deployment flow
svg.desc: A developer pushes to GitHub, which triggers a workflow. The self-hosted runner on EC2 builds a Docker image and replaces the running container. Users reach the app on port 9000.
svg.text: 1. Developer pushes a commit to main
3. Runner on EC2 picks up the job
4. docker build creates a new image
7. Users get the new version on port 9000
